title: Saffron Pilaf with Mascarpone Raita
description: A flavorful and creamy Indian-inspired pilaf dish paired with a cool and tangy mascarpone raita.

ingredients.name: saffron threads
ingredients.notes: soaked in 1 tablespoon of hot water

ingredients.name: plain yogurt
ingredients.notes: greek yogurt or regular plain yogurt

instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat.
Add the soaked saffron and its liquid, and stir for 1-2 seconds.
Add the pilaf and stir to coat with oil, then add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 15-20 minutes or until the pilaf is cooked.
In a separate bowl, mix together mascarpone, yogurt, cucumber, coriander, cumin, and salt.
Fluff the cooked pilaf with a fork and serve hot with the raita on the side.
Adjust seasoning as needed and garnish with chopped coriander if desired.
